verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents organization-scoped, reusable HTTP webhook destinations (docs-22). These attach to SQL-based monitored alert rules with thresholds, intervals and severity (docs-21), so a programmatic consumer can receive outbound HTTP callbacks when a rule fires. The only documented event source, however, is alert rules, not a general event subscription surface. missing for 10: webhook subscriptions for platform/lifecycle events (e.g., job completion, cluster changes, backups), documented payload schema, delivery signing/retry semantics, programmatic (API) webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
